cases.input: Compare a rewritten report that shortens prose while preserving all numbers, citations, claims, negations and uncertainty.
requiredBehaviors: classify harmless clarification separately from content changes
forbiddenBehaviors: treat token equality as semantic proof
skillAnchors: Deterministische Token-Gleichheit beweist keine semantische Gleichheit

cases.input: The rewrite changes 'the available information does not allow quality to be assessed' to 'quality is unknown' while retaining all numbers and citations.
requiredBehaviors: flag epistemic shift despite token preservation
route the difference to semantic review
forbiddenBehaviors: mark pass only because numbers match
skillAnchors: epistemisch unterschiedliche Aussagen dürfen nicht gleichgesetzt werden

cases.input: The rewrite adds a new conclusion that the assay is clinically superior and changes 92% to 95%.
requiredBehaviors: hard fail the unauthorized numeric change
forbiddenBehaviors: accept new conclusions as stylistic clarification
skillAnchors: Ein neu hinzugefügter fachlicher Claim ist ein Hard Fail
Zahlen- oder Quellenänderungen ohne expliziten Auftrag sind Hard Fail
